meta.name: hugging-science
meta.description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速查找并加载科学领域 AI 模型与数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在科研中用 AI 分析生物、化学或物理数据
copy.tagline_en: Find and load scientific AI models and datasets quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI for scientific research in biology, chemistry, or physics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Hugging Science 目录发现和使用科学领域的数据集、模型、博客和交互式演示，帮助完成生物、化学、物理等 AI/ML 任务。
howto.when: 当用户提及科学领域（如 biology、chemistry、physics 等）或询问科学数据集/模型、希望微调科学数据、复现科学 ML 论文时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个蛋白质序列数据集。
say.note: Claude 会从目录中推荐相关资源。

say.text: 如何用 ESM2 模型预测蛋白质功能？
有气候模型的数据集吗？
say.note: Claude 会搜索气候相关目录条目。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can discover and use scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive demos through the Hugging Science curated index, assisting with AI/ML tasks in domains like biology, chemistry, physics, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a scientific domain (e.g., biology, chemistry, physics) or asks for scientific datasets/models, wants to fine-tune on scientific data, or reproduce a scientific ML paper.

say_en.text: Find me a protein sequence dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend resources from the catalog.

say_en.text: How to use ESM2 for protein function prediction?
say_en.note: Claude will guide loading the model with transformers.
Claude will search climate-related catalog entries.
